title: hieracium vulgatum subsp. wainioi
intro: Hieracium vulgatum subsp. wainioi, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand its bioactive constituents and therapeutic potential.
